subject: How to specify the account which you want to deploy the application

messages.author: e3c4c58998a59e7b
messages.subject: How to specify the account which you want to deploy the application
parts:
When I call deployApp() I receive this error:

Error: Please specify the account which you want to deploy the application to (there is more than one account registered on this system).

I have just called shinyapps::setAccountInfo before deployApp. How do I further specify an account?

Thanks,
Joe

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to specify the account which you want to deploy the application
parts:
Joe,

The deployApp() function (and other functions) take an account parameter, e.g:

deployApp(account="joe") 

(Obviously replace joe with whatever your account name is)

Out of curiosity, why do you have two accounts?
